summary: 10.0.34.14 Enterprise Release - Full Desktop Parity for All 8 Import Modules: Native .xlsx Multi-Sheet Templates, SheetJS Parsing, Pre-Flight Master Validation Pipeline, True DB Persistence, Completion Dialog, and Audit Result Reports
highlights: 1. Native Multi-Sheet Excel Template Generation (.xlsx): Sheet 1 'Import Template' with formatted headers and example records, and Sheet 2 'Instructions' detailing field constraints, required flags, and data formats (matching Desktop ImportTemplateService.java)
2. SheetJS Binary (.xlsx / .xls) and CSV Parser: Offline xlsx.full.min.js engine supporting direct workbook loading, sheet layout detection, and multi-sheet resolution

3. Full 8-Module Registry & Column Auto-Mapping: Item Master, Customers CRM, Suppliers HRM, Sales Register, Purchase Bills, Master Categories, Purchase Recon, and Bank Statement (matching Desktop ImportModuleRegistry.java and ImportMappingSupport.java)

4. Deep Pre-Flight Validation Engine: ReferenceFormatRules regex evaluation, in-file duplicate detection, DB collision/mode policy (UPSERT, SKIP_EXISTING, UPDATE_NON_BLANK), cross-entity master lookups, and available stock checking

5. Genuine Database Persistence for All 8 Modules: Replaced mock responses with live Spring Boot REST API calls with exact DTO shapes for Sales, Purchases, Recon, Bank Statement, Items, Customers, Suppliers, and Master Lookups
6. Desktop Parity Completion Dialog Modal: Full execution summary displaying total processed, created, updated, skipped, failed counts, and error details
7. Two-Sheet Excel Audit Result Export: Generates downloadable Import_Result_<Module>_<Timestamp>.xlsx with Summary and Detailed Rows audit sheets
8. Seamless View Imported Records Navigation: Direct deep-linking from import completion to target ledger or register view
